excerpt.zh: 虚空之低语渴求超越平凡思维局限的知识。给予我们[Owner.GetResearchers]们广泛的授权，专注于深奥的研究领域，就可以寻求满足低语的渴望。
excerpt.en: The Whisperers in the Void yearn for knowledge beyond the limits of conventional thinking. By giving our [Owner.GetResearchers] a broad mandate to focus on esoteric areas of study, we can seek to satisfy the Whisperers' ardor.
